tags.name: Alert Configurations
tags.description: APIs for managing alert configurations — retrieve threshold rules and severity settings per alert type and scope.

get.description: This API endpoint retrieves the list of Alerts based on the query parameters provided. The alerts list includes details such as name, type, category, severity, status, etc. The query parameters allow you to filter results that meet specific criteria, ensuring you receive only relevant data.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
OData Version 4.0 filter string (limited functionality). Supports only 'and' conjunction ('or' and 'not' are NOT supported). Supported fields and operators are in the table below. 

| Field | Operators |
| --------- | -------- |
| `siteId` | `eq` and `in` |
| `typeId` | `eq` and `in` |
| `status` | `eq` and `in` |
| `category` | `eq` and `in` |
| `deviceType` | `eq` and `in`|

**The operators are implemented as follows:**

* `eq`: Only values exactly matching the given value are returned.
* `in`: Only values present in the given list are returned.

**List of applicable filters for field and terms:**

| Field | Applicable Terms |
| --------- | -------- |
|  `siteId` | `string` |
| `typeId` | `string` |
| `status` | `["Active", "Deferred", "Cleared"]` |
| `deviceType` | `["Access Point", "Gateway", "Switch", "Bridge", "Access Point, Switch", "Switch, Switch"]` |
| `category` | `["Clients", "System", "LAN", "WLAN", "WAN", "Cluster", "Routing", "Security"]` |

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field followed by a direction indicator ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). Supported fields are `createdAt`,`severity`,`status`,`name`,`priority`. `createdAt` field is used by default.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Specifies the pagination cursor for the next page of resources. Minimum value is 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of alerts to be retrieved. Allowed range is 1 to 100.

post.description: This API endpoint clears the specified alerts. Clearing an alert marks it as resolved with an optional reason and notes.
This API endpoint defers the specified alerts until a specified time. Deferred alerts will not generate notifications until the deferral period expires.
This API endpoint sets the specified alerts to active status. This can be used to reactivate deferred alerts.
This API endpoint sets the priority level for the specified alerts.

get.description: This API endpoint retrieves the classification of alerts based on the specified type. The classification provides aggregated counts of alerts grouped by the specified criteria.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The type of classification to retrieve. This determines how alerts are grouped. 
Possible values are `severity`, `status`, `priority`, `category`, `device_type`, `impacted_devices`

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: OData Version 4.0 filter string to filter the alerts before classification.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search string to filter alerts by name or summary before classification.

get.description:
Retrieves alert configurations for a given scope. Each configuration defines the threshold rules, severity mappings, and settings for a specific alert type. Configurations may be locally defined or inherited from a parent scope.

**Scope types:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `GLOBAL` | Tenant-level scope (default) |
| `SITE` | Site-level scope |
| `DEVICE` | Device-level scope |

**Pagination:**

Use `limit` and `next` together to page through large result sets. When `limit` is supplied the response includes `total` (total available configurations) and `offset` (zero-based index of the first item returned), enabling clients to determine whether additional pages exist.

parameters.name: scope-id
parameters.description: The scope identifier for which alert configurations are retrieved.

parameters.name: scope-type
parameters.description:
The scope type. Determines the level at which the configuration applies.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `GLOBAL` | Tenant-level scope (default) |
| `SITE` | Site-level scope |
| `DEVICE` | Device-level scope |

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of alert configurations to return per page. Defaults to `20` when not specified.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Zero-based offset of the first alert configuration to return. Use together with `limit` to paginate through results. Defaults to `0` when not specified.

get.description: This API endpoint retrieves the status of an asynchronous alert operation using the task ID returned from alert action endpoints (clear, defer, active, priority).

parameters.name: task-id
parameters.description: The unique task identifier returned from an alert action request.

get.description: Returns AI-powered recommendations for optimizing performance. For site-level granularity `site-id` and `insight-id` filter shall be provided and for global recommendations `site-id` and `insight-id` filter shall be omitted. At the global level, the API returns global recommendations (across all sites) along with siteId and insightId.

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: Site identifier. Omit site-id to retrieve global recommendations across all sites. For site-level recommendations site-id can be obtained from the same API from global recommendations through the field `siteId`.

parameters.name: insight-id
parameters.description: Insight identifier. `insight-id` is used to filter recommendations, it can be obtained from the same API from global-level recommendations through the field 'insightId'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of recommendations to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for recommendations based on implicit field insight-id.

get.description:
Returns the JSON schema definition for one or all available insights.

Behavior:
- If `insight-id` is provided, returns only the schema for that specific insight.
- If `insight-id` is omitted, returns schemas for all available insights as a JSON string.

parameters.name: insight-id
parameters.description: Insight type identifier (e.g. `702`). When omitted, all insight schemas are returned. `insight-id` can be obtained from global-level recommendations through the field `insightId`.
